title: Explicit image chain components and localization maps
statement: Using [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], for h:X→Y and an open W of Y, construct the sectionwise isomorphism h_*j_{h⁻¹W,*}r_{h⁻¹W} ≅ j_{W,*}r_W h_* by pushforward composition and the sectionwise restriction comparison. For any chain map f:h_*I→J, its W-component is this isomorphism followed by j_{W,*}r_W(f). Also construct the right-derived localization map on every complex and the corresponding open-image localization map. Their naturality and agreement with the canonical K-injective computation maps are proved. The restriction comparison is an abbreviation of [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model], not a second construction.
